newsitem.title: UK: Sterling prompts UK grain future rise in thin day.
newsitem.headline: Sterling prompts UK grain future rise in thin day.

text.p: An easier sterling prompted a rise in LIFFE grain futures in thin trade.
Currency remained the only real factor, traders said.
A late rally in sterling brought out some sellers.
"It is not insignificant that the bulk of the day's volume was done in the last part of trading," one said.
"Buyers were happy all day to pay 0.50 stg up," he said. "Sterling's rally prompted a few late sellers," he added.
Of the day's 232 lots, 149 were on May, by far the most active month. It last traded 0.25 stg up at 95.00 stg, having seen a high of 95.25 stg.
